svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts. Inserter arms load and unload the stores, a diverter flap picks a route, a hash pointer finds a bucket, and an LRU moves a node to the front of its list.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/42 a stream of byte chips leaves the rack
2/42 ring buffer: c lands in the tail sector and the tail arm turns
3/42 hash map: h(k3) = 2, so k3 lands in bucket 2
4/42 LRU: get(a) hashes to bucket 0 and finds node 2
5/42 a hit relinks a to the MRU end; nothing is copied
6/42 the cache is full: the LRU entry b is evicted and its bucket cleared
7/42 the tokenizer cuts a number and hands it to the branch
8/42 branch: kind == num, so the flap swings to the upper route
9/42 the press renders a glyph and the plate is painted
10/42 the next token is an operator
11/42 branch: else, so the flap swings down and the lock's gate turns
12/42 deque: push_front puts a at the front mouth
13/42 pop_back sends d on; the heap receives 1 in its last slot
14/42 heap: 1 is smaller than its parent 4, so they swap
15/42 1 is smaller than the root 3, swap again: the minimum is on top
16/42 bloom filter: three hashes of cat light bits 2, 7 and 10
17/42 DP table: each cell is filled from the one above and to the left
18/42 graph: a traversal visits A, then follows the edge to B
19/42 B's only edge leads to C, which A also reaches directly
20/42 the visit is published as an event
21/42 broadcast: every subscriber gets a copy; the counter ticks, the arena bumps
22/42 merge: both streams join into one
23/42 the joined result reaches the subscriber
24/42 WAL: commit is appended at the head and the commit mark moves up to it
25/42 slotted page: a new slot points at b=2, written from the bottom up
26/42 B+tree: 8 < 10, so the search goes down the first child
27/42 8 lands in the first leaf, still in sorted order
28/42 trie: looking up cat follows c
30/42 then t, a terminal node: cat is in the trie
31/42 pool: a worker checks out connection c2 to serve request 8
32/42 token bucket: request 9 takes a token; three are left
33/42 timer wheel: the hand ticks on and t3 is filed four slots ahead
34/42 double buffer: the next frame is drawn into the back pane
35/42 swap: the back pane becomes the one on screen
36/42 spatial grid: p1 crosses into the next cell; the split cell holds two
37/42 sorting · the digit arm lifts 3 off the passing belt into its bin
38/42 sorting · pipelined: + is already on the belt, and the operator arm takes it
39/42 sorting · 7 follows into the digits bin
40/42 sorting · ( matches no filter, so it rides to the end of the line
41/42 sorting · * goes to the operators bin: the stream is partitioned
42/42 sorting · operators ship to the parser on a belt that tunnels under the main line
